final: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT p.death_state, COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_id) AS player_count FROM hall_of_fame AS h JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = h.player_id GROUP BY p.death_state), overall AS (SELECT AVG(player_count) AS average_count FROM state_counts) SELECT AVG(s.player_count) AS average_count, AVG(s.player_count - o.average_count) AS average_excess FROM state_counts AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.player_count > o.average_count
